name: entitykit
description: An Entity Framework-inspired ORM for TypeScript with SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL providers.
author: zsumz <shawn@zsumz.com>

scripts.check:nextjs: npm run build && npm run verify --workspace @entitykit/example-nextjs-postgres
scripts.test:mutation: stryker run config/stryker/stryker.config.cjs && npm run test:mutation:migrations && npm run test:mutation:provider-validation && npm run test:mutation:sqlite-ddl && npm run test:mutation:checksum && npm run test:mutation:property-metadata && npm run test:mutation:snapshot-rename && npm run test:mutation:sqlite-rebuild && npm run test:mutation:sqlite-planning && npm run test:mutation:schema-ddl && npm run test:mutation:sqlite-joins && npm run test:mutation:primary-key-order && npm run test:mutation:migration-warnings && npm run test:mutation:primary-key-change && npm run test:mutation:postgres-generation && npm run test:mutation:store-generation && npm run test:mutation:mysql-types && npm run test:mutation:operation-signal && npm run test:mutation:json-validation && npm run test:mutation:postgres-schema-values && npm run test:mutation:mixed-index && npm run test:mutation:query-plan && npm run test:mutation:migration-table-order && npm run test:mutation:required-primary-key
scripts.release:alpha: node -e "console.error('Local publishing is not supported: dispatch the Release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check:security && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:nextjs && npm run check:bookshop && npm run check:api && npm run check:migration-compatibility && npm run check:operations && npm run check:performance && npm run check:package && npm run check:publish
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/require-postgres-url.js && node scripts/wait-for-postgres.js && RUN_POSTGRES_TESTS=true jest --config config/jest/jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/integration
scripts.test:integration:mysql: node scripts/require-mysql-url.js && node scripts/wait-for-mysql.js && RUN_MYSQL_TESTS=true jest --config config/jest/jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/integration
scripts.check:bookshop: npm run build && npm run verify --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop
scripts.check:bookshop:postgres: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && npm run qualify:postgres --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop
scripts.check:bookshop:mysql: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && npm run qualify:mysql --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop
scripts.check:migration-compatibility: npm run build && node scripts/check-migration-compatibility.js sqlite
scripts.check:migration-compatibility:postgres: npm run build && node scripts/check-migration-compatibility.js postgres
scripts.check:migration-compatibility:mysql: npm run build && node scripts/check-migration-compatibility.js mysql
scripts.check:operations: npm run build && node scripts/check-provider-operations.js sqlite
scripts.check:operations:postgres: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-provider-operations.js postgres
scripts.check:operations:mysql: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-provider-operations.js mysql
scripts.check:server-recovery:postgres: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-server-recovery.js postgres
scripts.check:server-recovery:mysql: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-server-recovery.js mysql
scripts.check:performance: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-performance.js sqlite
scripts.check:performance:postgres: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-performance.js postgres
scripts.check:performance:mysql: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @entitykit/example-bookshop && node scripts/check-performance.js mysql
